title: GUNFIRE HAS A TAIL THAT SAYS WHERE IT WAS FIRED
why: His yes on pick 69. A shot indoors now has a short bright room tail, a shot outside a crack and then a longer low thump that comes later the farther it is, and in the woods nothing. The tail rides the same muffled, panned path as the shot, so it is built on the v23.73 wall muffling.
now: Shots now sound like the place they are fired in: short and bright indoors, a crack and a low thump outside, dry in the woods.
